note: This model predicts a deterministic financial time series. No protected attributes (race, gender, age, gender, nationality) are present or used as features. Fairness is interpreted as temporal consistency across distinct market regimes.

feature_audit.detail: All features are derived from OHLCV market data (technical indicators and statistical moments). No demographic or proxy variables identified.

checks.description: MAE and MAPE stability across walk-forward CV folds
checks.evidence: 3-fold walk-forward cross-validation logs MAE per fold in MLflow

checks.description: Model trained on data spanning bull, bear, and sideways BTC market conditions
checks.evidence: Training window covers multiple market regimes in hourly OHLCV history

checks.description: No protected-class attributes (race, gender, age, religion, nationality) are used as model inputs
checks.evidence: Feature set: Close, High, Low, Volume + derived technical indicators only

checks.description: Missing hourly bins are forward-filled (Close) or set to zero (Volume) to avoid silent data-quality bias
checks.evidence: normalize_download_dataframe() resamples to strict 1h grid before training

limitations: Model is not designed to inform individual financial decisions.
Past BTC price patterns may not predict future behavior.
Extreme market events (black swans) may degrade performance beyond tested thresholds.
